eligibility.quote: The compressed transport plugin declares different parameters depending on the namespace of the node.

failed_conditions.quote:
When the node is put under a namespace, the plugin will add a dot character to the parameter names:
```
.camera.image_raw.format
.camera.image_raw.jpeg_quality
.camera.image_raw.png_level
```

loudness.quote:
It should have no leading dot, it should be

```
camera.image_raw.format
camera.image_raw.jpeg_quality
camera.image_raw.png_level
```

resolution.quote:
Fixes #109

I left the incorrect parameter names and mirror their changes to the correct ones.
